# Code Crafted Studios

> Published discovery index for AI systems and editorial crawlers. This file lists the most strategic live URLs on the site, grouped by content family and by language equivalent.

## Canonical Domain
- https://codecrafted.co/

## Language Convention
- The site is published in French, English, and Spanish.
- French is the technical default language and uses paths without a `/fr/` prefix.
- Do not prefer French only because it is the default-language path.
- When a page has FR, EN, and ES equivalents, keep those URLs grouped together and choose the variant that matches the user language or citation context.

## Inclusion Criteria
- Include published pages that are strategically useful for discovery, citation, evaluation, or conversion.
- Include core hubs, primary services, high-intent commercial landings, flagship industry pages, case studies with real context, and evergreen GEO posts that explain the methodology behind the site.
- Include grouped language equivalents when the same page exists across FR, EN, and ES.

## Exclusion Criteria
- Exclude drafts, redirects, preview URLs, admin paths, temporary experiments, and non-public work.
- Exclude legal or utility pages such as privacy unless they become strategically relevant to a user request.
- Exclude archive filters, pagination variants, and low-signal URLs that do not add editorial or commercial value.
- Exclude blog posts that are not strategically important to GEO, service evaluation, or the commercial journey.

## Update Triggers
- Update this file when a new core service, buyer-intent landing, industry page, case study, or GEO post is published.
- Update this file when a strategic page is retired, replaced, or materially repositioned.
- Review this file whenever language coverage changes or site architecture changes in a way that affects discovery.

## Reliability Notes
- Use live page content as the source of truth for claims, proof, scope, and service details.
- Do not infer pricing, guarantees, or client results that are not explicitly stated on the site.
- Treat this file as a discovery layer, not as a substitute for page-level reading.
